core_principles: Accessibility is not a feature, it's the foundation.
Warmth over sterility: Medical/Legal doesn't have to be cold.
Clarity is King: High contrast, large typography, distinct visual hierarchy.
Motion with Meaning: Animations guide the user, not distract them.

typography.installation_instructions: Add 'Outfit' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' via next/font/google in layout.tsx

icons.usage_rule: Use Duotone weight. Primary color for the icon body, Secondary/Opacity for the fill.

accessibility_checklist.contrast: Ensure text-to-background ratio is at least 4.5:1. Use deep indigo on white, or white on deep indigo. Avoid amber text on white.
accessibility_checklist.focus_states: Visible focus ring (ring-2 ring-indigo-600 ring-offset-2) on ALL interactive elements.
accessibility_checklist.aria: All icon-only buttons must have aria-label. Images must have alt text. Video players must have captions enabled by default.
accessibility_checklist.motion: Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion'. Wrap complex animations in 'useReducedMotion' check.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALLATION: Run 'npm install @phosphor-icons/react clsx tailwind-merge framer-motion sonner' immediately.
2. FONTS: Update 'src/app/layout.tsx' to include Outfit (headings) and Plus Jakarta Sans (body). Apply them globally.
3. THEME: Since tailwind.config.js is missing (v4), add the custom colors directly to 'src/app/globals.css' in the @theme block or root variables.
4. COMPONENTS: Do NOT use default Shadcn cards. Build custom 'Card' components using the 'visual_enhancers' guidelines.
5. MOTION: Use 'framer-motion' for a subtle 'fade-up' effect on sections as they scroll into view. (initial={{opacity:0, y:20}} whileInView={{opacity:1, y:0}}).
6. NAV: Create a 'Glass' Navbar that becomes solid on scroll.
7. EXPERT PAGE: Use a 'Bento Grid' layout for the expert listing, not a simple list.
8. ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure all video components have a placeholder for 'CC' and 'Transcript' controls.
9. ICONS: Use Phosphor Icons 'Duotone' weight. Example: <User size={32} weight='duotone' className='text-indigo-600' />
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
